name: spoiler-shield-for-youtube
description: Firefox extension that hides YouTube videos, Shorts, comments and search suggestions matching your keywords and blocks matching pages. Ships with a GTA 6 preset. Runs fully offline.
author: Db2203

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.sign:listed: web-ext sign --source-dir extension --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --channel listed --amo-metadata amo-metadata.json
